positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for the "Your Business on Yelp"​ email newsletter. This includes making sure the data needed to send the newsletter are ready on time and accurate.

Integrated promotion codes with the updated ads purchase flow. Also worked on measuring conversions (purchases made) through the new flow to compare against the previous flow.

Served as the project lead for the Message the Business feature. Included scoping of the project, task breakdown, serving as scrum leader, and implementation of the reply by email feature.

Served as the project lead to redesign the Yelp business owner site. The redesign also involved changes to the controller layer to incorporate SOA and Elastic Search to enhance existing functionality.

One of the primary developers for the "Call To Action" button. Includes the business logic to display the Call To Action widget, metrics collection, and refinement of the underlying schema.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Updated the Advertising Inquiry form to allow local businesses to search for their Yelp listing rather than have to input the data manually.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to Dakota, a tool to simulate the performance and operation of rechargeable lithium-ion batteries, and the general framework for simulating complex real-world physics using object oriented programming methods.
Identified problems in the first-principles model Dakota was based upon and implemented solutions given by the modeler.
Used design patterns to create complex objects for use in the simulation software. For example, I used the Facade design pattern to create a complex object by reusing existing simple objects of the same type.
